DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域の川柳募集についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the local senryu poetry contest?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人と一句作ったので、二人の名前で応募できるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人との合作川柳を二人名義で応募できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. A friend and I wrote a poem, and I would like to know whether we can enter it under both our names.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can submit a senryu co-written with a friend under both your names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 作品は、どのようにお二人で作られたのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: How did the two of you create the poem?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人が最初の言葉を考えて、私が後半を考えました。最後に二人で読み直して直しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 各自の創作部分と共同で推敲した経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend thought of the opening words, and I came up with the latter half. Finally, we both reread it and made revisions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain which part each person created and how you revised it together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 合作の応募と作者名の書き方について、募集担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check with the organizer about joint entries and how to write the authors' names.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。一人の名前しか欄に入らないからといって、私だけが作ったことにはしたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 単独作者として記載せず合作の表記を確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Just because the field only has room for one name, I do not want to make it look as though I wrote it alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check how to credit a joint work rather than listing yourself as the sole author. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご友人は、応募することに同意されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Has your friend agreed to entering it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 応募したいとは話しましたが、この募集へ出すことと名前の載せ方は、もう一度友人と確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 募集への応募と名前の掲載は友人へ再確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: We have talked about wanting to enter, but I will check again with my friend about submitting to this contest and how our names will appear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm the entry in this contest and publication of your names with your friend again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 応募条件を確認してから、お二人でご相談ください。受け付けられると今ここでお約束はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please discuss it together after checking the entry requirements. I cannot promise here and now that it will be accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。条件を聞き、友人と名前の書き方まで決めてから応募します。今日は問い合わせだけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件確認と友人との合意後に応募し当日は問い合わせだけにすると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I will ask about the requirements and agree with my friend on how to write our names before entering. Today I will just make an inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to enter after checking the requirements and agreeing with your friend, and to make only an inquiry today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当への問い合わせ方法をご案内します。それでは、お二人での作品作りもお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will explain how to contact the organizer. I hope you both enjoy creating your poems. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 携帯の通知が鳴っていますが、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your phone notification is sounding. Do you need any help?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いつもの薬の時間を知らせる通知です。今日は診察待ちなので、ここで飲んでいいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 普段の服薬通知が鳴り待合中の服薬を迷うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is my usual reminder to take my medicine. I am waiting for my consultation today, so I am unsure whether I should take it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your usual medication reminder has sounded and you are unsure about taking it while waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 服薬のことは看護師へおつなぎします。まず通知音を止めていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will put you in touch with a nurse about your medicine. Could you first silence the notification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 音は止めました。薬を飲んだという記録は、まだ付けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知音だけ止め服薬済みの記録は付けていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have stopped the sound. I have not yet recorded that I have taken the medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have only silenced the notification and have not marked the medicine as taken. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実際には、今日のその薬はまだ飲んでいないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you have not actually taken that medicine today yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。通知を消しただけです。飲む時間を変えてよいかも、自分では決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未服薬で時刻変更も自己判断していないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: That is right. I only dismissed the notification. I cannot decide on my own whether I may change the time I take it, either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make clear that you have not taken the medicine and have not decided on your own to change the time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 看護師に、普段の時刻と今の状況をお伝えください。薬の情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell the nurse your usual time and your current situation. Do you have the medication information with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 薬の袋を持っています。携帯の通知画面と一緒に見せて、今日どうすればよいか尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薬袋と通知を示して看護師へ相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the medicine bag. I will show it along with the notification screen on my phone and ask what I should do today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will show the medicine bag and notification and consult the nurse. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その内容で看護師にご相談ください。受付から飲み方の判断はいたしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please discuss those details with the nurse. Reception staff do not decide how you should take your medicine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。ここで急いで飲まず、まだ飲んでいないことから説明して相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未服薬の事実から説明し看護師の相談を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I will not rush to take it here. I will begin by explaining that I have not taken it yet and ask for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will start by explaining that you have not taken the medicine and wait to consult the nurse. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、看護師へお声掛けしますので、少しお待ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will call the nurse, so please wait a moment. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 携帯の画面について、お困りのことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there something about your phone screen that you need help with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鞄から携帯を出したら、緊急の連絡先へ発信するような画面が出ていました。電話がかかったかどうか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯に緊急発信らしい画面が出たが発信済みか不明と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I took my phone out of my bag, a screen appeared that looked like it was calling an emergency contact. I do not know whether a call went through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help because a possible emergency-call screen appeared on your phone, but you do not know whether it made a call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どなたかと通話したり、相手の声を聞いたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you speak with anyone or hear anyone's voice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 声は聞いていません。画面を見た時には驚いて閉じたので、その前の状態が分からないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通話音は聞かず画面を閉じる前の状態は不明と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not hear a voice. When I saw the screen, I was startled and closed it, so I do not know what state it was in before that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you heard no voice and do not know the screen's state before closing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: いま分かることを順に確認しましょう。通話の履歴を、ご自身で開けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check what we know in order. Can you open the call history yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 履歴は開けます。ただ、画面の意味が分からないので、確かめるためにもう一度発信することはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人が履歴を開き確認目的の試し発信はしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can open the history. But I do not understand what the screen means, so I will not call again just to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will open the history yourself and will not make a test call to check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのまま画面を拝見します。いつ、どの状態で気づいたかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will look at the screen as it is. Please also tell me when and in what circumstances you noticed it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十分ほど前、鞄を膝に置いていた時です。携帯を取り出して初めてその画面に気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 画面に気づいた時刻と携帯を鞄に入れていた状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: About ten minutes ago, when my bag was on my lap. I only noticed the screen after I took the phone out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain when you noticed the screen and that the phone had been in your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できた表示と、ご本人が覚えている操作を分けてお聞きします。分からない操作は分からないままで結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will ask separately about what the display confirms and what actions you remember taking. It is fine to say you do not know about actions you are unsure of.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 覚えているのは、取り出して画面を閉じたところだけです。それより前にボタンを押したかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記憶している操作と不明な操作を区別して答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: All I remember is taking it out and closing the screen. I do not know whether I pressed any buttons before that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish between the actions you remember and the ones you do not know about. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。いま見える履歴から一緒に確認しましょう。それでは、こちらへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us check together, starting with the history we can see now. Please come this way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒でお送りになる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to send it in this envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 祖父に家族の手紙を送ります。みんなが少しずつ書いたのですが、私の字だけ小さくなってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 祖父への家族の寄せ書きで自分の文字だけ小さいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending my grandfather a letter from the family. Everyone wrote a little, but only my handwriting ended up small.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that only your writing is small in the family's joint letter to your grandfather. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いまは、まだ封をしていないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not sealed it yet, then?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。祖父は大きい字の方が読みやすいと言っていたので、私の部分を書き直してから入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未封で祖父の読みやすさに合わせて書き直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. My grandfather said larger writing is easier to read, so I would like to rewrite my part before putting it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that it is not sealed and you want to rewrite your part so your grandfather can read it easily. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 書き直した手紙をご用意いただいてから、封筒や料金を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once your rewritten letter is ready, we can check the envelope and postage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここで職員の方に書いてもらうのではなく、家で自分の部分を大きく書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 窓口への代筆依頼でなく自宅で本人が書き直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Instead of asking a staff member here to write it for me, I will rewrite my own part in larger writing at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will rewrite it yourself at home rather than ask counter staff to write it for you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご家族の書いたページは、どのようにされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: What will you do with the pages your family wrote?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そのまま一緒に入れます。誰の手紙か分かるように、私の新しいページにも名前を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族の原稿を残し自分の新しいページにも署名すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will include them as they are. I will put my name on my new page too, so it is clear whose letter it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you will keep your family's original pages and sign your own new page too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 中身がそろってから、封筒に収まるか確認してください。厚くなる場合は窓口で拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you have all the contents, please check whether they fit in the envelope. If it becomes thick, let us see it at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ページが増えるので、いま料金を決めず、書き直した手紙を持って改めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ページが増えた完成物で封筒と料金を再相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: There will be more pages, so I will not decide the postage now. I will bring the rewritten letter and ask again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to discuss the envelope and postage again using the finished letter with its extra pages. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご家族の手紙がそろいましたらお越しください。お待ちしています。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please come back when all your family's letters are ready. We look forward to seeing you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 貯金の計画についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a savings plan, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。残業がある月とない月で手取りが違うので、毎月いくら貯めるか決めにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残業で月ごとの手取りが変わり貯金額を決めにくいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My take-home pay differs between months with and without overtime, so it is hard to decide how much to save each month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that overtime changes your monthly take-home pay, making it hard to set a savings amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いちばん収入の多い月を基準にすると、少ない月に負担が出るかもしれません。生活費は整理されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you base it on your highest-income month, it may become a burden in lower-income months. Have you listed your living expenses?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家賃など毎月必要な分は書きました。食費はまだ見直しているので、今日すぐに金額を決めたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 固定費は整理したが食費が未整理で即決したくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have written down what I need every month, such as rent. I am still reviewing food expenses, so I do not want to decide an amount right away today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have listed fixed expenses but are still reviewing food costs and do not want to decide immediately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず生活に必要なお金を確保できる範囲を考えましょう。貯めたお金を使う予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, let us consider what you can afford while keeping enough money for daily living. Do you have a planned use for your savings?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帰国する時の交通費です。帰国日はまだ決まっていないので、期限に追われず少しずつ準備したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 日程未定の帰国交通費を徐々に用意したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Travel costs for returning to my home country. I have not set a return date yet, so I want to prepare gradually without being pressed by a deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to gradually save for travel home, with the date still undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 毎月の負担と目的を整理してから、どの方法が合うか相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once we have clarified your purpose and monthly burden, we can discuss which method suits you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 収入の少ない月でも困らない金額から考えて、余裕のある月は別に追加できるか検討します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 低収入月に支障がない額と余裕月の追加を検討すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will start by considering an amount that will not leave me short even in lower-income months, and look into whether I can add extra separately in months when I have more to spare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will consider an affordable amount for low-income months and extra contributions in better months. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 具体的な方法の条件は、次の相談で一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the conditions of specific methods together at your next consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 生活費の記録をそろえてからまた来ます。今日は高い目標額を先に決めず、続けられる範囲を持ち帰って考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 生活費記録をそろえ継続可能な範囲を考えて再相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will come back once I have gathered my living-expense records. Today, instead of setting a high target first, I will go home and think about what I can maintain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to gather your expense records, consider a sustainable amount, and return for advice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、記録をご用意できましたら、またご相談ください。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please consult us again when your records are ready. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 量り売りの商品で、何かお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about goods sold by weight?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家で使っている容器を持ってきました。この容器に豆を入れて、重さを量って買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参容器で豆を量って購入できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought the container I use at home. Can I put beans in this container and have them weighed to buy them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can buy beans by weight in your own container. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この売場では、こちらの指定の袋で量っていただく扱いです。持参された容器では量れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this section, items must be weighed in our designated bags. We cannot weigh them in containers brought from home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。まだ容器には入れていません。指定の袋に、必要な分だけ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未充填で指定袋を使い必要量を買うと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. I have not put anything into the container yet. I will put just the amount I need into the designated bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you have not filled the container and will use the designated bag to buy only what you need. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋の置き場所はこちらです。豆の種類ごとに分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The bags are here. Please keep each type of bean separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二種類を少しずつ買うので、袋も二つ使います。混ぜた状態で量らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二種類の豆を別々の袋へ入れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am buying small amounts of two kinds, so I will use two bags. I will make sure they are not mixed when weighed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will put the two types of beans in separate bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋にある商品の番号も、種類に合わせてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check that the product number on the bag matches the type.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらの豆はこの番号ですね。もう一種類の番号は、そちらの表示を見てから記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 各豆の表示から商品番号を確認すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: This is the number for these beans, right? I will check the sign for the other kind before writing down its number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will check the product number on each bean's label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記入と計量が終わりましたら、会計へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you have written the numbers and finished weighing, please take them to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それぞれの袋を量って番号も確かめました。容器への移し替えは家に帰ってからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋ごとに計量し帰宅後に容器へ移すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have weighed each bag and checked the numbers too. I will transfer them to my container after I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have weighed each bag and will transfer the beans to your container at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、そのまま会計へどうぞ。少量のお買物にもご利用ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please take them straight to the checkout. You are welcome to use this section for small purchases too. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りの支度でしょうか。お子さんは、まだ遊びたいようですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you getting ready to go home? Your child seems to want to keep playing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: そうなんです。夕飯の支度があるので帰りたいのですが、もう少しだけと言って動きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夕食準備で帰りたいが子どもが遊びをやめないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to go home to prepare dinner, but my child keeps saying just a little longer and will not move.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice because you want to go home to prepare dinner, but your child will not stop playing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何をして遊んでいたのですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 砂で町を作っていました。壊れるのが嫌で、完成するまで帰れないと思っているみたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 砂の町を完成させたい子の気持ちを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: They were building a town out of sand. They do not want it to fall apart and seem to think they cannot leave until it is finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your child's wish to finish the sand town. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 頑張って作ったのですね。今日できたところを、一緒に見てあげてはいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: They worked hard on it. How about looking together at what they have managed to make today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず、できた町の話を聞いてみます。明日まで必ず残ると約束せず、今日作ったところを覚えておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 当日の成果を聞き翌日まで作品が残るとは約束しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: First, I will listen to them talk about the town they have made. I want to remember what they built today without promising it will definitely still be here tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will listen to what your child achieved today without promising the creation will remain until tomorrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次に来たら何を作りたいかも、お子さんに聞けそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You could also ask what they would like to build on their next visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 聞いたら、今度は橋を作りたいそうです。その楽しみを次回へ残して、今日は道具を一緒に片付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次回は橋を作る希望を聞き当日は親子で道具を片付けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I asked, and they say they want to build a bridge next time. We will leave that fun for our next visit and put away the tools together today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you heard your child wants to build a bridge next time and will put away the tools together today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 道具を袋へ入れる前に、砂を落としてください。置き忘れもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please shake the sand off the tools before putting them in the bag. Check that you have not left anything behind too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 道具を数えて片付けました。町の話を聞いてから次の橋の話をしたら、子どもも帰る支度を始めました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 道具を確認し次回の話で子が帰り支度を始めたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I counted the tools and put them away. After I listened to the story of the town and talked about the next bridge, my child started getting ready to go home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that you checked the tools and talking about the next visit helped your child start getting ready to leave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 次の橋作りが楽しみですね。それでは、お子さんと気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Building that bridge next time will be fun. Please have a safe journey home with your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 楽器をお持ちですね。何かお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have an instrument with you. Do you need any help?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この長いケースが横に出てしまいます。混んでいるので、人に当てずに改札を通りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長い楽器ケースを人に当てず改札へ進みたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: This long case sticks out to the side. It is crowded, so I want to get through the ticket gate without hitting anyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help getting to the ticket gate without hitting people with your long instrument case. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ケースを縦に持てますか。いったん列の脇で持ち方を整えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you hold the case upright? Please step to the side of the queue first and adjust how you are carrying it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 縦にすると持てます。肩に掛けたまま回ると先が振れるので、手で支えて進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 脇でケースを縦に持ち手で先を支えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can carry it upright. If I turn with it still on my shoulder, the end swings out, so I will support it with my hand as I walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will move aside, hold the case upright, and support its end with your hand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご一緒の方は、先に改札へ向かわれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is the person with you already heading toward the ticket gate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。友人は急いでいますが、私は同じ速さで歩けません。先に行って、ホームで待ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者には先行してホームで待ってもらうと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. My friend is in a hurry, but I cannot walk at the same speed. I will have them go ahead and wait on the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will have your companion go ahead and wait on the platform. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの通路をご案内します。急いで追いかけず、ケースの先にも気をつけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will show you this passage. Please do not hurry after your friend, and watch the end of the case too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この向きなら周りに当たりにくいですね。自分で運べますので、案内だけお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人が運べるため経路の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: This way round, it is less likely to hit people nearby. I can carry it myself, so please just show me the route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for directions along the route because you can carry the case yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、前の方が通り終えてからお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait until the person in front has passed through before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 前が空くまで待ちます。友人には、自分のペースで改札を通ると伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 前が空くまで待ち友人に自分の速度で進むと連絡したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait until the way ahead is clear. I told my friend I would go through the gate at my own pace.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait until the way is clear and have told your friend you will proceed at your own pace. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、ゆっくりお進みください。それでは、楽器と一緒にお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please take your time. Have a safe journey with your instrument.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 広報について、どのようなことをお知りになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to know about the community bulletin?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 長い文章を読むと目が疲れます。地域の催しを知りたいので、音声で聞けるものがあるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長文で目が疲れ催し情報を音声で聞く方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My eyes get tired when I read long passages. I want to learn about local events, so please tell me whether there is anything I can listen to in audio.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to listen to event information in audio because long texts tire your eyes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日本語の説明を聞くことはできますか。それとも別の言語での案内をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you listen to explanations in Japanese, or would you prefer information in another language?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日本語で聞けば分かります。翻訳よりも、目を休めながら情報を聞ける方法を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日本語は聞いて理解でき翻訳より情報形式の調整を希望すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand when I hear Japanese. Rather than translation, I am looking for a way to hear information while resting my eyes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you understand spoken Japanese and want a change of information format rather than translation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 音声で提供している情報の範囲を、担当へ確認しましょう。特に知りたい催しはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us ask the person in charge what information is available in audio. Is there a particular event you want to know about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 来月の市民交流の催しです。日時と会場、それから申込みが必要かを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 来月の交流催しの日時と会場と申込要否を知りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Next month's community exchange event. I want to know the date and time, the venue, and whether registration is required.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want the date and time, venue, and registration requirements for next month's exchange event. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その三点を伝えて確認します。音声に載っていない情報もあるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask about those three points. Some information may not be included in the audio.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もし全部は聞けないなら、足りないところだけ窓口で説明してもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 音声で不足する情報のみ窓口説明を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I cannot hear everything, it would help if staff at the counter could explain just the missing parts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you would like counter staff to explain only the information missing from the audio. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用できる形式と、説明を受けられる窓口を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check the available formats and which counter can provide explanations, then let you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。日本語が分からないという相談ではなく、読む時に疲れることも担当の方へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 読字の疲労という相談理由を担当者へ伝えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. Please also tell the person in charge that I am asking because reading makes my eyes tired, not because I do not understand Japanese.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask that the person in charge be told your reason for asking is fatigue when reading. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、そのご希望もお伝えします。それでは、確認が終わるまで少しお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, I will pass on that request too. Please wait a little while we check. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どうされましたか。お話ししづらそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: What is the matter? You seem to be having difficulty speaking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: せきが出て、続けて話せません。少し座ってから説明してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: せきで連続して話せず座ってから説明したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am coughing and cannot speak continuously. May I sit down for a bit before explaining?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to sit before explaining because coughing prevents you from speaking continuously. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 看護師に声を掛けます。いま、短くでも伝えておきたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will call a nurse. Is there anything you would like to tell us now, even briefly?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝からせきが続いています。長い説明は難しいですが、看護師の方に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今朝からのせきと看護師への相談希望を短く伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have been coughing since this morning. It is difficult to give a long explanation, but I would like to consult a nurse.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Briefly explain that you have been coughing since this morning and want to consult a nurse. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらに座ってお待ちください。ご無理に話を続けなくて結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please sit here and wait. You do not need to force yourself to keep talking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。家で症状を書いたメモがあります。話せない部分は、それを見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自宅で書いた症状メモで口頭説明を補いたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I have a note about my symptoms that I wrote at home. I would like them to read it for the parts I cannot say aloud.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you would like a symptom note you wrote at home to supplement your spoken explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: メモはご本人の手元に置いて、看護師が来たらお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the note with you and show it to the nurse when they arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここに置いて待ちます。せきの合間に、確認されたことだけ短く答えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: メモを本人の手元に置き確認された点に短く答えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will keep it here while I wait. Between coughs, I will give brief answers only to what I am asked to confirm.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the note with you and answer briefly about the points you are asked to confirm. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 看護師へ、せきで話が続けられないことを伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I told the nurse that your cough prevents you from continuing to speak.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 助かります。説明を全部言い切ろうとせず、休みながら相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 無理に説明を言い切らず休みながら相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: That helps. I will consult them while taking breaks rather than trying to say the entire explanation in one go.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will take breaks during the consultation without forcing yourself to finish the explanation all at once. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、看護師が参ります。つらさが増した時は、すぐにお声掛けください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: The nurse will be here shortly. If you feel worse, please tell us immediately. Goodbye.
